text: 2026年8月10日至2026年8月14日，上交所对98起拉抬打压、虚假申报等证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，对爱丽家居、百花医药等严重异常波动股票以及财通福鑫LOF等溢价较高的基金进行重点监控，对38起上市公司重大事项等进行专项核查，向证监会上报涉嫌违法违规案件线索6起。
text_en: From August 10, 2026 to August 14, 2026, the Shanghai Stock Exchange imposed self-regulatory measures on 98 cases of abnormal securities trading behavior such as price manipulation and false orders, closely monitored stocks with severe abnormal fluctuations such as Ellay Home and Baihua Medicine as well as funds with high premiums such as Caitong Fuxin LOF, conducted special reviews of major matters involving 38 listed companies, and reported 6 suspected illegal or non-compliant case leads to the CSRC.
